Name: (CP) Maximalism - Sorcery
Author: smallcopper
Description:
Here it is, first of a few new updates. Go get my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35731]catalogue[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35730]Kitchenalia[/url], and the new update of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26106]the original Maximalism[/url] to complete the collection!

Thanks for all the excitement on my teeny little 'coming soon' thing, it really helped and forced me to get this stuff out there:) 

Install with Content Patcher. The items should appear in whatever design/cheat/library mod you happen to be using...or the catalogue:)
(An AT version combining everything is on the way. sit tight)

Again as always, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] for decorating...awesome.
I don't have a simple list of stuff used in my screenshots, but if anyone has any 'where did you get [x]?' type questions, drop me a comment and i'll try and point you in the right direction!

Let me know if anything's buggy, have fun cluttering magically like the magical clutterers you are.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44091]Chinese translation[/url] now available! (thanks @dogfood233)
